raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Delivery batch 12 (ingested 2026-01-17) sent txn_ts as epoch-millisecond strings (for example '1768543592000') instead of 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS', so CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) fails. 1768543592000 ms decodes to 2026-01-16 06:06:32 UTC, which matches the time-of-day pattern of the other batches (previous-day transactions starting around 06:00), so the values can be converted deterministically with epoch_ms.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, ts AS txn_ts, CAST(ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(trim(txn_ts), '^[0-9]{13}$') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(trim(txn_ts) AS BIGINT)) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') s"}}
